name: Hospital bed
parts: base frame with grey shroud and four 125 mm casters with brake pedals
steel deck frame with four deck sections (head, seat, thigh, foot)
navy vinyl mattress in four segments with fitted linen sheet
two head rails riding the head section and two foot rails
molded headboard and footboard with grey inserts
caregiver control panel on the footboard and a hanging control pendant with cord
wall bumper rollers at the head end
style: Contemporary med-surg bed (Hill-Rom Centrella / Stryker S3 class), 89 x 203 cm mattress, deck 40-76 cm; warm white plastics, navy mattress, made-up linen with a dented pillow and a folded blanket.
summary: Med-surg hospital bed: four-section deck on lift columns and braked casters, split side rails, head and footboards, pendant, sheeted mattress and pillow.
